title: Creamy Polish Penne Pasta
description: A simple yet delicious pasta dish from Poland, featuring penne pasta in a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the polish cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the cooked penne pasta and the creamy sauce in a large serving dish.
